meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Urban co-operative banks state by state and region by region: number of banks, branches, deposits, advances, districts reached, extension counters and ATMs
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 800, the Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks' Outlook, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service (one grid per edition, as on 31 March; a March printed by two editions takes the later edition's figure). Table 10. Andhra Pradesh before the 2014 split and Jammu and Kashmir before 2019 are their own series. Counts rescaled where an edition prints them on another scale, fixed by its all-India number of UCBs against report 812: 2014 (×0.01), 2015 (×10), 2016 (×10), 2017 (×10), 2018 (×10). State counts left empty where they do not add up to the all-India figure (rounded to tens in print): 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018.
